@returns One of the addresses found by the last [CountHostAddresses](CountHostAddresses), as text, or an empty string when there is none.
@param host_index  The address to take, counting from 1.
@gap Without a call of [CountHostAddresses](CountHostAddresses) the addresses of this computer are used. Not in the original, which only knows IPv4 ([HostIP](HostIP)). See [IPv6](IPv6).
